many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def blocks(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    rs=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(inp[r]))==1]; cs=[c for c in range(W) if len({inp[i][c] for i in range(H)})==1]
    rs.append(H); cs.append(W)
    cnts=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    return sorted(rs),sorted(cs),cnts.most_common(1)[0][0]

            ocnt=Counter(out[i][j] for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d))

            v=next(iter(ocnt)) if u else None
            nm=sum(cnt[x] for x in cnt if x!=bg)
            print((a,b,c,d),'outuniform',u,'val',v,'counts',dict(cnt),'noise',nm)

    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    rs=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(inp[r]))==1]

        d=cs[b_idx+1] if b_idx<len(cs)-1 else W
        blk=(rs[a],rs[a+1],c,d)
        cnt=Counter(inp[i][j] for i in range(*blk[:2]) for j in range(blk[2],blk[3]))

from collections import Counter
def parts(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    rs=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(inp[r]))==1]
    cs=[c for c in range(W) if len({inp[i][c] for i in range(H)})==1]
    return rs,cs
def analyze(p):
    inp,out=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    rs,cs=parts(inp)
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    # separator color: forms full rows/cols
    sepv=None
    for v in others:
        s=sum(1 for r in inp if all(x==v for x in r)) + sum(1 for c in range(W) if all(inp[i][c]==v for i in range(H)))
        if s>0: sepv=v
    noise=[v for v in others if v!=sepv][0]
    print(f'--- demo {p}: bg={bg} sep={sepv} noise={noise}')
    for a in range(len(rs)-1):
        for b_idx in range(len(cs)-1):
            r0=rs[a]; r1=rs[a+1]; c0=cs[b_idx]; c1=cs[b_idx+1]
            pts=[(i-r0,j-c0) for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1) if inp[i][j]==noise]
            ovals=sorted({out[i][j] for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1)})
            npts=len(pts); nbg=(r1-r0)*(c1-c0)-npts
            print((r0,c0), 'nnoise',npts,'area',(r1-r0)*(c1-c0),'outuniform',len(ovals)==1,'outval',ovals[0] if len(ovals)==1 else '-')
    return None
for p in ['1','2','3','4','5']: analyze(p)

from collections import Counter
def comps(pts):
    # 4-connectivity
    S=set(pts); seen=set(); out=[]
    for p in pts:
        if p in seen: continue
        st=[p]; seen.add(p); c=set()
        while st:
            q=st.pop(); c.add(q)
            for d in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                r_=(q[0]+d[0],q[1]+d[1])
                if r_ in S and r_ not in c: st.append(r_)
        out.append(c)
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g, fill, sep):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    ridx=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==sep for v in g[i])]
    cidx=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(h))]
    rs=[-1]+ridx+[h]; cs=[-1]+cidx+[w]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        for c,d in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            blk=[(x,y) for x in range(a,b) for y in range(c,d)]
            if any(g[x][y]==fill for x,y in blk):
                for x,y in blk:
                    if g[x][y]!=sep: res[x][y]=fill
    return res

    others=[v for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=sep]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def bands(g,sep):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    ridx=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==sep for v in g[i])]
    cidx=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(h))]
    rs=[-1]+ridx+[h]; cs=[-1]+cidx+[w]
    return rs,cs
for k,fill in [('Demo pair 6',3),('Demo pair 7',9)]:
    I=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r); sep=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    rs,cs=bands(I,sep)
    print(k,'sep',sep)
    for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        for c,d in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            blk=[(x,y) for x in range(a,b) for y in range(c,d)]
            n=sum(1 for x,y in blk if I[x][y]==fill)
            ch=all(O[x][y]==fill for x,y in blk if I[x][y]!=sep) if any(O[x][y]==fill for x,y in blk) else None
            print(f"R{a}C{c}: n={n} filled={ch}")

def blocks(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    rs=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==I[i][0] for v in I[i])]
    cs=[j for j in range(w) if all(I[i][j]==I[0][j] for i in range(h))]
    RS=[-1]+rs+[h]; CS=[-1]+cs+[w]
    return RS,CS

for k in ['Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    I=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    RS,CS=blocks(I)
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    bg=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seps=[c for c in set(v for r in I for v in r) if len(lines(c))>0]
    sep=min(seps,key=lambda c:sum(r.count(c) for r in I))
    fill=min([c for c in vals if c not in (bg,sep)],key=lambda c:vals[c])
    print('===',k,'sep',sep,'fill',fill)
    for a,b in zip(RS,RS[1:]):
        for c,d in zip(CS,CS[1:]):
            cnt=sum(1 for x in range(a,b) for y in range(c,d) if I[x][y]==fill)
            outcnt=sum(1 for x in range(a,b) for y in range(c,d) if O[x][y]==fill and I[x][y]!=sep)
            # did this block get fully filled in output?
            full=all(O[x][y]==fill for x in range(a,b) for y in range(c,d) if I[x][y]!=sep)
            if cnt>0 or full:
                print(f'  R{a}-{b-1} C{c}-{d-1}: markers={cnt} filled_in_out={full}')
